verses.pali: “Idhāhaṁ, āvuso, gijjhakūṭā pabbatā orohanto addasaṁ usulomaṁ purisaṁ vehāsaṁ gacchantaṁ.
verses.english: “Just now, reverend, as I was descending from Vulture’s Peak Mountain I saw a man whose body hairs were arrows flying through the air.

verses.pali: Tassa te usū uppatitvā uppatitvā tasseva kāye nipatanti.
verses.english: And those arrows kept rising up and falling on his body

verses.pali: eso, bhikkhave, satto imasmiṁyeva rājagahe kāraṇiko ahosi …pe….
verses.english: “That being used to be a punisher right here in Rājagaha. …”
